```{python}
#| output: asis
from pdi import home, site
from pdi.common.paths import ROOT

items, week_meta = site.load("unusual", "week")
prices, _ = site.load("tech-value", "price_history")
move = home.top_price_move(items, prices)
brief = home.latest_brief(ROOT / "site" / "briefs")

if brief:
    brief_text = f'<p>Latest edition: <a href="{brief["href"]}">{brief["title"]}</a>.</p>'
else:
    brief_text = "<p>First edition covers November 2026.</p>"

CALENDAR = (
    '<svg class="home-brief-icon" viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" '
    'stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">'
    '<rect x="6" y="11" width="52" height="46" rx="7"/><path d="M6 24h52M20 5v12M44 5v12"/>'
    '<g fill="currentColor" stroke="none"><rect x="15" y="31" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/>'
    '<rect x="26" y="31" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="37" y="31" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/>'
    '<rect x="48" y="31" width="5" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="15" y="42" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/>'
    '<rect x="26" y="42" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="37" y="42" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/>'
    '<rect x="48" y="42" width="5" height="6" rx="1"/></g></svg>'
)

cards = (
    '<div class="home-cards">'
    + home.this_week_card(items, week_meta, move)
    + '<section class="home-card home-brief" aria-labelledby="home-brief-title">'
    '<div class="home-brief-body"><h2 id="home-brief-title">Monthly brief</h2>'
    "<p>New readings, revisions and which earlier signals held.</p>"
    + brief_text
    + '<a class="home-btn home-btn-outline" href="briefs/index.html">View brief archive '
    '<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></div>'
    + CALENDAR
    + "</section></div>"
)
print("```{=html}\n" + cards + "\n```")
```
